package probe_test

import (
	"testing"

	"lydite.example/probe"
)

// Helper is exported from an external test package, which no module can
// import. It is removed by the excluded-packages shape.
func Helper() {}

func TestCached(t *testing.T) {
	if probe.Cached("k") != "k" {
		t.Fatal("the probe's own suite is never run; it exists to be a package the loader must leave out")
	}
}
